summary: Fixed 2 issues from QA: (1) Changed LOG_LEVEL to BP_LOG_LEVEL in docker-compose.yml orchestrator service so BP_LOG_LEVEL=debug from .env is actually forwarded to the container. (2) Added 9 integration tests under tests/integration/test_otel_pipeline.py covering configurable port start, POST /v1/traces acceptance, debug-level logging of all span types, info-level filtering to session events only, invalid-payload best-effort handling, empty body handling, start/stop idempotency, 404 on wrong path, and env-var wiring verification. All 202 tests pass, ruff lint clean.
